item.title: Hubble 1.0.7
item.description:
Hubble 1.0.7
Hubble 1.0.7: Companion feedback reminders and easier button editing
- HubDash and the web interface now show a centered popup when configured Companion controls are missing Hubble appearance feedback. Install the missing feedbacks or dismiss reminders until the next Hubble launch. - Install missing feedbacks directly from Hubble Service Settings, with progress and verified results. Existing Companion actions, styles, layout, and feedbacks are preserved. - Add multiple buttons at once with the new quantity dialog. Right-click a saved button to insert above, below, or at the bottom, or delete selected buttons. Insertion and deletion retain undo support and preserve whole interaction groups. - Verified feedback installation and duplicate prevention with Companion 4.3.4 and 5.0.5.
